name: Shippo
summary: Multi-carrier shipping software for e-commerce. Compare rates, print discounted labels and automate tracking across carriers — shipping that scales with your store.
best_for: e-commerce sellers shipping across multiple carriers who want rate comparison, label printing and tracking in one place with genuine rate discounts
skip_if: you ship a handful of packages monthly through one carrier (their native tools are fine), or you're big enough for direct carrier contracts to beat aggregated rates
honest_knock: The pricing is honest but layered. The free tier stops at 30 labels a month, and its 5¢ per label on your own carrier accounts quietly adds up. Pro looks like a flat $17 a month until you read the comparison table: it covers up to 10,000 shipments and then bills $0.08 for every label beyond that, so a good sales month adds a variable line to a subscription that reads as fixed. Address validation outside the US is metered too, at 9¢, 8¢ or 6¢ depending on plan. The real money is elsewhere anyway — in the carrier rate discounts, which vary by lane and weight. Run your five most common shipments through it against your current rates; that comparison decides, not the subscription price.

pricing.notes: Read on their own pricing page, re-verified 25 September 2026. Starter is free: up to 30 labels a month, discounted USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express rates, 1 user login, and 5¢ per label if you connect your own carrier account. Pro is banded by monthly label volume, priced monthly or annually: 1-200 labels $19/mo or $205/yr; 201-500 $29 or $313; 501-1,000 $54 or $583; 1,001-2,500 $79 or $853; 2,501-5,000 $139 or $1,501; 5,001-10,000 $199 or $2,149. Annual billing saves about 10% at every band. Labels beyond 10,000 a month cost $0.08 each. Pro makes your own carrier accounts free and adds branded tracking, chat and phone support. Premier is contact-us: unlimited shipments, 15+ logins, a dedicated account manager. Non-US address validation is metered separately at 9¢, 8¢ and 6¢ per validation on Starter, Pro and Premier. API calls not tied to a Shippo label, and the Estimate API, bill at API Starter rates.
